They are in neighboring energy sectors but earn money differently: regulated rates for delivery versus market-priced commodity sales. Their customers also differ: retail and building customers versus marketers and processors.

T:P2.3.text: Con Edison's principal business segments are Consolidated Edison Company of New York, a regulated electric, gas, and steam utility; Orange & Rockland Utilities (O&R), a regulated electric and gas utility; and Con Edison Transmission, Inc.

T:P2.4.text: Con Edison of New York provides electric service to multiple million customers and gas service to multiple million customers in New York City and Westchester County. The company also provides steam service in parts of Manhattan. Visit Con Edison’s website.

T:P2.5.text: Orange & Rockland provides electric service to multiple customers in southeastern New York and adjacent areas of northern New Jersey and gas service to multiple customers in southeastern New York. Visit Orange & Rockland’s website.

T:P2.6.text: Con Edison Transmission invests in electric and natural gas transmission projects that offer customers access to diverse, low-cost energy supplies. Visit Con Edison Transmission’s website.

C:P1.3.text: Turning What’s Next Into What’s Now

C:P1.4.text: At BKV, we combine thinking fast and thinking forward. This unique combination empowers us to meet tomorrow’s energy demands today—strategically, responsibly, reliably.

C:P1.5.text: An Energy Chain With No Weak Links

C:P1.6.text: This is energy reengineered. BKV’s business lines don’t operate in silos. Instead, they operate as a system. C:P1.8.text: BKV is built to perform. Big ideas don’t sit on the sidelines here. They scale. Fueled by collaboration and disciplined execution, we’re not just growing; we’re transforming what energy can be.

C:P1.9.text: We’re meeting growing electricity demand head-on. With existing power generation assets and clear pathways to scale, we’re perfectly positioned at the nexus of AI, data-center and industrial expansion in Texas.
